<DOCSTRING>
Represents a user with a name and age, providing functionality to check if the user is an adult.

Description:
The User class is used to store user information and determine if the user is an adult based on their age. It is created by various services and used by other components to validate user access and permissions.

Attributes:
    name (str): The user's name, set during initialization and not modified afterward.
    age (int): The user's age, set during initialization and not modified afterward.
</DOCSTRING>
